“Mosques are being demolished today, but they will be rebuilt tomorrow.” Jamiat Ulama-e-Hind president Maulana Arshad Madani made this statement while addressing a conference in Deoband, Saharanpur. He spoke about action against mosques and madrasas, Muslim religious identity, and the role of Islamic institutions. Citing the example of the Soviet Union, Madani argued that faith cannot be erased through force. He also highlighted the role of madrasas in education, moral development and building children’s character.
